raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, rows from the new 'v2' collector have timestamps shifted 6 hours later than legacy local time. In the samples, v2 rows start at about 12:00 while legacy rows start at 06:00, which is merchant opening. Because of the shift, late-evening v2 transactions fall into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which moves them to the wrong txn_date and creates the 36-row 2026-01-19 stub. The fix normalizes v2 timestamps by subtracting 6 hours before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
